def receive_request(data):
        user = actor()
        require_role(user, 'PA Receiver')
        request = lock_request(data.get('name'), data)
        if request.status != 'Approved':
            fail('error.status')
        old = document_values(request)
        request.status = 'Closed'
        request.received_by = user
        request.received_at = frappe.utils.now()
        persist(request)
        audit(request, 'Receive', checked_text(data.get('comment'), 2000), old)
        return request_details(request)
